items.source: beanName - the name of the bean
items.translation: beanName - 豆子的名称

items.source: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - if there is no bean with the given name
items.translation: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - 如果不存在具有给定名称的 Bean

items.source: name - the name of the bean to query
items.translation: name - 要查询的 Bean 的名称

items.source: Translates aliases back to the corresponding canonical bean name.
items.translation: 将别名还原为对应的标准 Bean 名称。

items.source: Will ask the parent factory if the bean cannot be found in this factory instance.
items.translation: 如果在此工厂实例中找不到该 Bean，将向父工厂询问。

items.source: Return an instance, which may be shared or independent, of the specified bean.
items.translation: 返回指定 Bean 的实例，该实例可能是共享的或独立的。

items.source: BeanDefinitionStoreException - in case of an invalid bean definition
items.translation: BeanDefinitionStoreException - 在无效 Bean 定义的情况下

items.source: name - the name of the bean to retrieve
items.translation: name - 要检索的 Bean 的名称

items.source: a (potentially merged) RootBeanDefinition for the given bean
items.translation: 给定 Bean 的（可能已合并）RootBeanDefinition

items.source: BeansException - if the bean could not be created
items.translation: BeansException - 如果无法创建该 Bean

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean definition
items.translation: beanName - Bean 定义的名称

items.source:
Depending on the nature of the concrete bean factory implementation,
this operation might be expensive (for example, because of directory lookups
in external registries). However, for listable bean factories, this usually
just amounts to a local hash lookup: The operation is therefore part of the
public interface there. The same implementation can serve for both this
template method and the public interface method in that case.
items.translation: 具体取决于 BeanFactory 实现的类型，此操作可能代价高昂（例如，由于在外部注册表中执行目录查找）。然而，对于可列举的 BeanFactory，这通常仅涉及本地哈希查找：因此，该操作是该公共接口的一部分。在这种情况下，相同的实现可同时用于此模板方法和公共接口方法。

items.source: Determine whether an embedded value resolver has been registered with this bean factory, to be applied through ConfigurableBeanFactory.resolveEmbeddedValue(String).
items.translation: 确定是否已在此 Bean 工厂中注册了嵌入式值解析器，以便通过 `ConfigurableBeanFactory.resolveEmbeddedValue(String)` 应用。

items.source: Check whether the given bean is defined as a FactoryBean.
items.translation: 检查给定的 Bean 是否被定义为 `FactoryBean`。

items.source:
Initialize the given PropertyEditorRegistry with the custom editors
that have been registered with this BeanFactory.
items.translation: 使用已注册到此 BeanFactory 的自定义编辑器初始化给定的 PropertyEditorRegistry。

items.source: args - arguments to use when creating a bean instance using explicit arguments (only applied when creating a new instance as opposed to retrieving an existing one)
items.translation: args - 使用显式参数创建 Bean 实例时要使用的参数（仅适用于创建新实例，而不是检索现有实例）

items.source: requiredType - the required type of the bean to retrieve
items.translation: requiredType - 要检索的 Bean 所需类型

items.source: name - the user-specified name
items.translation: name - 用户指定的名称

items.source: bd - the original bean definition (Root/ChildBeanDefinition)
items.translation: bd - 原始 Bean 定义（Root/ChildBeanDefinition）

items.source: mbd - the corresponding bean definition
items.translation: mbd - 对应的 Bean 定义

items.source: an instance of the bean
items.translation: bean 的实例

items.source: This class provides a singleton cache (through its base class DefaultSingletonBeanRegistry, singleton/prototype determination, FactoryBean handling, aliases, bean definition merging for child bean definitions, and bean destruction (DisposableBean interface, custom destroy methods). Furthermore, it can manage a bean factory hierarchy (delegating to the parent in case of an unknown bean), through implementing the HierarchicalBeanFactory interface.
items.translation: 该类通过其基类DefaultSingletonBeanRegistry提供单例缓存，并支持单例/原型判定、FactoryBean处理、别名、子 bean 定义的 bean 定义合并以及 bean 销毁（包括DisposableBean接口和自定义销毁方法）。此外，它可以通过实现HierarchicalBeanFactory接口来管理 bean 工厂层次结构（在遇到未知 bean 时委托给父工厂）。

items.source: The main template methods to be implemented by subclasses are getBeanDefinition(String) and createBean(String, RootBeanDefinition, Object[]), retrieving a bean definition for a given bean name and creating a bean instance for a given bean definition, respectively. Default implementations of those operations can be found in DefaultListableBeanFactory and AbstractAutowireCapableBeanFactory.
items.translation: 子类需要实现的主要模板方法是getBeanDefinition(String)和createBean(String, RootBeanDefinition, Object[])，它们分别用于获取给定 bean 名称的 bean 定义以及为给定的 bean 定义创建 bean 实例。这些操作的默认实现可以在DefaultListableBeanFactory和AbstractAutowireCapableBeanFactory中找到。

items.source: For a FactoryBean, return the type of object that the FactoryBean creates, as exposed by FactoryBean.getObjectType(). This may lead to the initialization of a previously uninitialized FactoryBean (see BeanFactory.getType(String, boolean)).
items.translation: 对于 `FactoryBean`，返回该 FactoryBean 创建的对象类型，如由 `FactoryBean.getObjectType()` 所暴露。这可能导致先前未初始化的 `FactoryBean` 被初始化（参见 `BeanFactory.getType(String, boolean)`）。

items.source: If no FactoryBean.OBJECT_TYPE_ATTRIBUTE is set on the bean definition and allowInit is true, the default implementation will create the FactoryBean via getBean to call its getObjectType method. Subclasses are encouraged to optimize this, typically by inspecting the generic signature of the factory bean class or the factory method that creates it. If subclasses do instantiate the FactoryBean, they should consider trying the getObjectType method without fully populating the bean. If this fails, a full FactoryBean creation as performed by this implementation should be used as fallback.
items.translation: 如果未在 Bean 定义上设置 FactoryBean.OBJECT_TYPE_ATTRIBUTE，且 allowInit 为 true，默认实现将通过 getBean 创建 FactoryBean，以调用其 getObjectType 方法。子类应优化此过程，通常通过检查工厂 Bean 类的泛型签名或创建该工厂的方法来实现。如果子类确实实例化了 FactoryBean，它们应考虑在未完全填充 Bean 的情况下尝试调用 getObjectType 方法；如果失败，则应使用本实现执行的完整 FactoryBean 创建作为后备方案。

items.source: For a FactoryBean, return the type of object that the FactoryBean creates, as exposed by FactoryBean.getObjectType(). Depending on the allowFactoryBeanInit flag, this may lead to the initialization of a previously uninitialized FactoryBean if no early type information is available.
items.translation: 对于 `FactoryBean`，返回该 FactoryBean 创建的对象类型，如由 `FactoryBean.getObjectType()` 所暴露。根据 `allowFactoryBeanInit` 标志，如果无法获取早期类型信息，这可能导致对先前未初始化的 `FactoryBean` 进行初始化。

items.source: Behaves the same as BeanFactory.getBean(String), but provides a measure of type safety by throwing a BeanNotOfRequiredTypeException if the bean is not of the required type. This means that ClassCastException can't be thrown on casting the result correctly, as can happen with BeanFactory.getBean(String).
items.translation: 与BeanFactory.getBean(String)的行为相同，但通过在不满足所需类型时抛出 BeanNotOfRequiredTypeException 来提供一定程度的类型安全性。这意味着在正确转换结果时不会抛出 ClassCastException，而使用BeanFactory.getBean(String)则可能发生此类情况。

items.source: If a bean definition or singleton instance matching the given name is found, this method will return true whether the named bean definition is concrete or abstract, lazy or eager, in scope or not. Therefore, note that a true return value from this method does not necessarily indicate that BeanFactory.getBean(String) will be able to obtain an instance for the same name.
items.translation: 如果找到与给定名称匹配的 Bean 定义或单例实例，无论该命名 Bean 定义是具体的还是抽象的、懒加载的还是非懒加载的、是否在作用域内，此方法都将返回 `true`。因此，请注意，从此方法返回 `true` 并不一定表示 BeanFactory.getBean(String) 能够获取相同名称的实例。

items.source: Note: This method returning false does not clearly indicate independent instances. It indicates non-singleton instances, which may correspond to a scoped bean as well. Use the BeanFactory.isPrototype(String) operation to explicitly check for independent instances.
items.translation: 注意：此方法返回 `false` 并不能明确表示独立实例。它表示非单例实例，这可能对应于作用域 Bean。请使用 BeanFactory.isPrototype(String) 操作来显式检查独立实例。

items.source: Note: This method returning false does not clearly indicate a singleton object. It indicates non-independent instances, which may correspond to a scoped bean as well. Use the BeanFactory.isSingleton(String) operation to explicitly check for a shared singleton instance.
items.translation: 注意：此方法返回 `false` 并不能明确表示这是一个单例对象。它表示非独立实例，这可能对应于一个作用域 Bean。请使用 BeanFactory.isSingleton(String) 操作来显式检查共享的单例实例。

items.source: Such a registrar creates new PropertyEditor instances and registers them on the given registry, fresh for each bean creation attempt. This avoids the need for synchronization on custom editors; hence, it is generally preferable to use this method instead of ConfigurableBeanFactory.registerCustomEditor(Class, Class).
items.translation: 此类注册器会为每次尝试创建 Bean 时创建新的 PropertyEditor 实例，并将其注册到给定的注册表中。这避免了对自定义编辑器进行同步的需要；因此，通常更倾向于使用此方法，而不是ConfigurableBeanFactory.registerCustomEditor(Class, Class)。

items.source: Note that this method will register a shared custom editor instance; access to that instance will be synchronized for thread-safety. It is generally preferable to use ConfigurableBeanFactory.addPropertyEditorRegistrar(PropertyEditorRegistrar) instead of this method, to avoid for the need for synchronization on custom editors.
items.translation: 请注意，此方法将注册一个共享的自定义编辑器实例；对该实例的访问将实现同步以确保线程安全。通常更倾向于使用 ConfigurableBeanFactory.addPropertyEditorRegistrar(PropertyEditorRegistrar) 而不是此方法，以避免对自定义编辑器进行同步的需求。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to registerCustomEditors(PropertyEditorRegistry). Can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 默认实现委托给registerCustomEditors(PropertyEditorRegistry)。可在子类中重写。

items.source: This getMergedBeanDefinition considers bean definition in ancestors as well.
items.translation: 此 `getMergedBeanDefinition` 也会考虑祖先中的 Bean 定义。

items.source: Typically triggered after changes to the original bean definitions, for example, after applying a BeanFactoryPostProcessor. Note that metadata for beans which have already been created at this point will be kept around.
items.translation: 通常在原始 Bean 定义发生变化后触发，例如在应用了 `BeanFactoryPostProcessor` 之后。请注意，此时已经创建的 Bean 的元数据将被保留。

items.source: The default implementation registers the prototype as currently in creation.
items.translation: 默认实现将原型注册为当前正在创建的状态。

items.source: The default implementation marks the prototype as not in creation anymore.
items.translation: 默认实现会将原型标记为不再处于创建状态。

items.source:
Any exception that arises during destruction should be caught
and logged instead of propagated to the caller of this method.
items.translation: 任何在销毁过程中引发的异常都应被捕获并记录，而不是传播到此方法的调用者。

items.source:
To be called for BeanWrappers that will create and populate bean
instances, and for SimpleTypeConverter used for constructor argument
and factory method type conversion.
items.translation: 用于创建和填充 Bean 实例的 BeanWrapper，以及用于构造函数参数和工厂方法类型转换的 SimpleTypeConverter。

items.source:
Subclasses can override this to derive additional cached state
from the final post-processed bean definition.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法，从最终的已后处理的 Bean 定义中派生额外的缓存状态。

items.source:
This allows the bean factory to optimize its caching for repeated
creation of the specified bean.
items.translation: 这允许 Bean 工厂针对指定 Bean 的重复创建优化其缓存。

items.source:
The default implementation checks the DisposableBean interface as well as
a specified destroy method and registered DestructionAwareBeanPostProcessors.
items.translation: 默认实现会检查 DisposableBean 接口、指定的销毁方法以及已注册的 DestructionAwareBeanPostProcessor。

items.source: All bean retrieval methods delegate to this method for actual bean creation.
items.translation: 所有 Bean 获取方法都委托给此方法进行实际的 Bean 创建。

items.source: Internal extended variant of isTypeMatch(String, ResolvableType) to check whether the bean with the given name matches the specified type.
items.translation: 内部扩展的 `isTypeMatch(String, ResolvableType)` 变体，用于检查给定名称的 Bean 是否与指定类型匹配。

items.source: Specify a ConversionService to use for converting property values, as an alternative to JavaBeans PropertyEditors.
items.translation: 指定一个用于转换属性值的ConversionService，作为 JavaBeans PropertyEditors 的替代方案。

items.source: Internal extended variant of isTypeMatch(String, ResolvableType) to check whether the bean with the given name matches the specified type. Allow additional constraints to be applied to ensure that beans are not created early.
items.translation: 内部扩展的 isTypeMatch(String, ResolvableType) 变体，用于检查给定名称的 bean 是否与指定类型匹配。允许应用额外的约束以确保不会过早创建 bean。

items.source: Return the ApplicationStartup for this bean factory.
items.translation: 返回该 Bean 工厂的ApplicationStartup。

items.source: Return this factory's class loader for loading bean classes (only null if even the system ClassLoader isn't accessible).
items.translation: 返回此工厂的类加载器以加载 Bean 类（如果连系统 ClassLoader 都不可访问，则返回 `null`）。

items.source: Return the parent bean factory, or null if there is none.
items.translation: 返回父 Bean 工厂，如果没有则返回null。

items.source: Create a new AbstractBeanFactory.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 AbstractBeanFactory。

items.source: Create a new AbstractBeanFactory with the given parent.
items.translation: 使用给定的父对象创建一个新的 AbstractBeanFactory。

items.source: Add a String resolver for embedded values such as annotation attributes.
items.translation: 添加一个用于嵌入值（如注解属性）的 String 解析器。

items.source:
Check the given merged bean definition,
potentially throwing validation exceptions.
items.translation: 检查给定的合并 Bean 定义，可能会抛出验证异常。

items.source: Perform appropriate cleanup of cached metadata after bean creation failed.
items.translation: 在 Bean 创建失败后，执行适当的缓存元数据清理。

items.source:
Remove the merged bean definition for the specified bean,
recreating it on next access.
items.translation: 删除指定 Bean 的合并 Bean 定义，并在下次访问时重新创建它。

items.source:
Destroy the given bean instance (usually a prototype instance
obtained from this factory) according to the given bean definition.
items.translation: 根据给定的 Bean 定义销毁给定的 Bean 实例（通常是从该工厂获取的原型实例）。

items.source:
Evaluate the given String as contained in a bean definition,
potentially resolving it as an expression.
items.translation: 评估作为 Bean 定义中包含的给定 String，并可能将其解析为表达式。

items.source: Return the aliases for the given name, if defined.
items.translation: 如果已定义，则返回给定名称的别名。

items.source: Return the resolution strategy for expressions in bean definition values.
items.translation: 返回 Bean 定义值中表达式的解析策略。

items.source: Return the current number of registered BeanPostProcessors, if any.
items.translation: 返回当前已注册的 BeanPostProcessor 的数量（如果有的话）。

items.source:
Return the list of BeanPostProcessors that will get applied
to beans created with this factory.
items.translation: 返回将应用于通过此工厂创建的 Bean 的 BeanPostProcessor 列表。

items.source: Return the associated ConversionService, if any.
items.translation: 返回关联的 ConversionService（如果有）。

items.source: Return the map of custom editors, with Classes as keys and PropertyEditor classes as values.
items.translation: 返回自定义编辑器的映射，其中键为类（Classes），值为属性编辑器类（PropertyEditor classes）。

items.source: Return the custom TypeConverter to use, if any.
items.translation: 返回要使用的自定义 TypeConverter（如果有）。

items.source:
Return a RootBeanDefinition for the given top-level bean, by merging with
the parent if the given bean's definition is a child bean definition.
items.translation: 为给定的顶层 Bean 返回一个 RootBeanDefinition，如果给定 Bean 的定义是子 Bean 定义，则将其与父 Bean 合并。

items.source:
Return a RootBeanDefinition for the given bean, by merging with the
parent if the given bean's definition is a child bean definition.
items.translation: 为给定的 Bean 返回一个 RootBeanDefinition；如果给定 Bean 的定义是一个子 Bean 定义，则将其与父 Bean 合并。

items.source:
Return a merged RootBeanDefinition, traversing the parent bean definition
if the specified bean corresponds to a child bean definition.
items.translation: 返回一个合并的 RootBeanDefinition，如果指定的 Bean 对应于子 BeanDefinition，则遍历父 BeanDefinition。

items.source:
Get the object for the given bean instance, either the bean
instance itself or its created object in case of a FactoryBean.
items.translation: 获取给定 Bean 实例的对象，对于 FactoryBean，该对象为 Bean 实例本身或其创建的对象。

items.source: Return the set of PropertyEditorRegistrars.
items.translation: 返回 PropertyEditorRegistrars 集合。

items.source:
Return the temporary ClassLoader to use for type matching purposes,
if any.
items.translation: 返回用于类型匹配目的的临时 ClassLoader（如果有）。

items.source: Determine the type of the bean with the given name.
items.translation: 确定给定名称的 Bean 的类型。

items.source:
Return whether this factory holds a DestructionAwareBeanPostProcessor
that will get applied to singleton beans on shutdown.
items.translation: 返回该工厂是否持有将在关闭时应用于单例 Bean 的 DestructionAwareBeanPostProcessor。

items.source:
Return whether this factory holds a InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor
that will get applied to singleton beans on creation.
items.translation: 返回该工厂是否持有将在创建单例 Bean 时应用的 InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor。

items.source:
Determine whether the specified bean is eligible for having
its bean definition metadata cached.
items.translation: 确定指定的 Bean 是否符合缓存其 Bean 定义元数据的条件。

items.source:
Return whether to cache bean metadata such as given bean definitions
(in merged fashion) and resolved bean classes.
items.translation: 返回是否缓存 Bean 元数据（如以合并方式给出的 Bean 定义和解析后的 Bean 类）。

items.source: Determine whether the bean with the given name is a FactoryBean.
items.translation: 确定给定名称的 Bean 是否为 FactoryBean。

items.source:
Return whether the specified prototype bean is currently in creation
(within the current thread).
items.translation: 返回指定的原型 Bean 当前是否正在创建中（在当前线程内）。

items.source: Check whether the bean with the given name matches the specified type.
items.translation: 检查给定名称的 Bean 是否与指定类型匹配。

items.source: Determine the original bean name, resolving locally defined aliases to canonical names.
items.translation: 确定原始 Bean 名称，将本地定义的别名解析为规范名称。

items.source: Register the given scope, backed by the given Scope implementation.
items.translation: 注册给定的作用域，该作用域由给定的 Scope 实现支持。

items.source:
Remove the singleton instance (if any) for the given bean name,
but only if it hasn't been used for other purposes than type checking.
items.translation: 移除给定 Bean 名称的单例实例（如果有），但前提是它尚未用于除类型检查之外的其他用途。

items.source:
Resolve the bean class for the specified bean definition,
resolving a bean class name into a Class reference (if necessary)
and storing the resolved Class in the bean definition for further use.

items.source:

and resolving aliases to canonical names.

items.source:

by this factory. To be invoked during factory configuration.

items.source:

i.e. whether any bean has been marked as created in the meantime.

items.source:

i.e. whether there is a local bean or alias registered under this name or
an inner bean created with this name.

items.source:
Add the given bean to the list of disposable beans in this factory,
registering its DisposableBean interface and/or the given destroy method
to be called on factory shutdown (if applicable). Only applies to singletons.
items.translation: 将给定的 Bean 添加到该工厂的可销毁 Bean 列表中，注册其 `DisposableBean` 接口和/或给定的销毁方法，以便在工厂关闭时调用（如适用）。仅适用于单例。

items.source: an instance of the bean. Note that the return value will never be null but possibly a stub for null returned from a factory method, to be checked via equals(null). Consider using BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(Class) for resolving optional dependencies.

items.source: an instance of the bean. Note that the return value will never be null. items.source: Note: Post-processors submitted here will be applied in the order of registration; any ordering semantics expressed through implementing the Ordered interface will be ignored. Note that autodetected post-processors (for example, as beans in an ApplicationContext) will always be applied after programmatically registered ones.
items.translation: 注意：在此处提交的后置处理器将按注册顺序应用；通过实现Ordered接口所表达的排序语义将被忽略。请注意，自动检测到的后置处理器（例如作为 ApplicationContext 中的 Bean）将始终在程序化注册的后置处理器之后应用。

items.source: This is an alternative to containsBean, ignoring a bean of the given name from an ancestor bean factory.
items.translation: 这是 `containsBean` 的替代方案，它会忽略来自祖先 Bean 工厂中给定名称的 Bean。

items.source: A temporary ClassLoader is usually just specified if load-time weaving is involved, to make sure that actual bean classes are loaded as lazily as possible. The temporary loader is then removed once the BeanFactory completes its bootstrap phase.
items.translation: 如果涉及加载时织入，通常只需指定一个临时 ClassLoader，以确保实际 bean 类尽可能延迟加载。一旦 BeanFactory 完成引导阶段，该临时加载器即被移除。

items.source:
This method allows a Spring BeanFactory to be used as a replacement for the
Singleton or Prototype design pattern. Callers may retain references to
returned objects in the case of Singleton beans.
items.translation: 此方法允许将 Spring BeanFactory 用作单例或原型设计模式的替代方案。调用者可以保留对单例 Bean 返回对象的引用。

items.source:
Allows for specifying explicit constructor arguments / factory method arguments,
overriding the specified default arguments (if any) in the bean definition.
Note that the provided arguments need to match a specific candidate constructor /
factory method in the order of declared parameters.
items.translation: 允许指定显式的构造函数参数/工厂方法参数，覆盖 Bean 定义中指定的默认参数（如果有）。请注意，提供的参数必须按照声明参数的顺序与特定的候选构造函数/工厂方法相匹配。

items.source:
If the given name is an alias, it will be translated back to the corresponding
canonical bean name.
items.translation: 如果给定的名称是别名，它将被转换回对应的规范 Bean 名称。

items.source:
If this factory is hierarchical, will ask any parent factory if the bean cannot
be found in this factory instance.
items.translation: 如果该工厂是分层的，当在此工厂实例中找不到该 Bean 时，将向任何父工厂进行询问。

items.source:
Note that the parent cannot be changed: It should only be set outside
a constructor if it isn't available at the time of factory instantiation.
items.translation: 注意父对象不可更改：它仅在工厂实例化时无法提供该对象的情况下，才应在构造函数之外设置。

items.source:
Note that this class loader will only apply to bean definitions
that do not carry a resolved bean class yet. This is the case as of
Spring 2.0 by default: Bean definitions only carry bean class names,
to be resolved once the factory processes the bean definition.
items.translation: 请注意，此类加载器仅适用于尚未携带已解析的 Bean 类的 Bean 定义。自 Spring 2.0 起默认情况即如此：Bean 定义仅携带 Bean 类名称，待工厂处理该 Bean 定义时再进行解析。

items.source:
Turn this flag off to enable hot-refreshing of bean definition objects
and in particular bean classes. If this flag is off, any creation of a bean
instance will re-query the bean class loader for newly resolved classes.
items.translation: 关闭此标志以启用 Bean 定义对象的刷新，特别是 Bean 类。如果关闭此标志，创建任何 Bean 实例时将重新查询 Bean 类加载器以获取新解析的类。

items.source:
There is no expression support active in a BeanFactory by default.
An ApplicationContext will typically set a standard expression strategy
here, supporting "#{...}" expressions in a Unified EL compatible style.
items.translation: BeanFactory 默认没有激活表达式支持。ApplicationContext 通常在此处设置标准的表达式策略，以兼容统一 EL 风格的 "#{...}" 表达式。

items.source:
This will override the default PropertyEditor mechanism and hence make
any custom editors or custom editor registrars irrelevant.
items.translation: 这将覆盖默认的 PropertyEditor 机制，从而使任何自定义编辑器或自定义编辑器注册器变得无关紧要。

items.source:
If the default PropertyEditor mechanism is active, the returned
TypeConverter will be aware of all custom editors that have been registered.
items.translation: 如果默认的 PropertyEditor 机制处于活动状态，则返回的 TypeConverter 将了解所有已注册的自定义编辑器。

items.source:
This will only return the names of explicitly registered scopes.
Built-in scopes such as "singleton" and "prototype" won't be exposed.
items.translation: 这将仅返回显式注册的 Scope 名称。像"singleton"和"prototype"这样的内置 Scope 将不会被暴露。

items.source:
This will only return explicitly registered scopes.

items.translation: 这将仅返回显式注册的 Scope。内置的 Scope，如 "singleton" 和 "prototype"，将不会被暴露。

items.source: This allows the application context to record metrics during application startup.
items.translation: 这允许应用程序上下文在应用启动期间记录指标。

items.source:
Should include all standard configuration settings as well as
BeanPostProcessors, Scopes, and factory-specific internal settings.
Should not include any metadata of actual bean definitions,
such as BeanDefinition objects and bean name aliases.
items.translation: 应包含所有标准配置设置，以及 BeanPostProcessor、作用域和工厂特定的内部设置。不应包含实际 bean 定义的元数据，例如 BeanDefinition 对象和 bean 名称别名。

items.source:
This implementation is simplistic in that it is not able to
handle factory methods and InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessors.
It only predicts the bean type correctly for a standard bean.
To be overridden in subclasses, applying more sophisticated type detection.
items.translation: 此实现过于简单，无法处理工厂方法和 `InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor`。它仅能正确预测标准 Bean 的 Bean 类型。应在子类中重写该方法，以应用更复杂的类型检测机制。
